title: Item creation: Sol recovery review
lede: Keep unfinished inventory intake recoverable and protect edited drafts. Existing tracking choices remain intact.

sections.heading: Matched local fixture evidence
sections.note: Baseline is the exact pre-review dirty source snapshot; actual React forms are bundled. API mutation results are fixture responses, with no database inventory writes. Same viewport, clock, source data and scroll settings.

pairs.title: Unfinished batch recovery
pairs.sub: 1280 CSS px; same fixture steps and scroll.
pairs.afterCap: The failed identity, organization, QR and shipment notes survive.

pairs.title: Copied product notice
pairs.sub: 1280 CSS px; same fixture steps and scroll.
pairs.beforeCap: Description occupied the narrow icon column.
pairs.afterCap: Description uses the full content column.

pairs.title: Quantity draft image
pairs.sub: 1280 CSS px; same fixture steps and scroll.
pairs.beforeCap: Switching to existing stock erased the staged image.
pairs.afterCap: Switching back restores the new-item draft and image.

pairs.title: Tablet batch recovery
pairs.sub: 768 CSS px; same fixture steps and scroll.
pairs.beforeCap: The remaining row lost its identity.
pairs.afterCap: The remaining row stays ready to correct and retry.

changes.was: The handoff unmounted the form; Fix remaining reopened blank.
changes.now: Intake stays mounted and hidden during the handoff. Retained keys and error focus stay valid; hidden intake cannot resubmit. Leaving unfinished rows requires confirmation.

changes.was: Start a different item or retry source could clear edited details immediately.
changes.now: Keep editing preserves the copied draft and returns focus; confirmation clears it.

changes.was: Add to existing cleared the staged image while other create fields survived.
changes.now: New-item details and image survive the round trip; adjusting existing stock keeps its record image unchanged.

changes.was: Descriptions after a title occupied the 1rem icon column.
changes.now: Scoped creation notices use the full content column.

verification: 26 focused tests, TypeScript, scoped lint and final application build passed. Build reports the pre-existing Sidebar unused-state warning.

Local Chromium fixture at 1280, 768 and 390 CSS px: partial success, retry-only-unfinished, conflict focus, hidden submit guard, canceled partial exit followed by regular discard, copy reset cancel/confirm, Quantity image preservation. No page errors.

Authenticated branch preview at 1280 and 768 CSS px: typing, tracking cancel/focus and confirm, Quantity image/name round trip, discard cancel/confirm. No inventory mutation attempts or failed API responses. Background analytics requests were blocked.
notes: Local-only changes. No staging, commit, push or deployment.
Partial-batch POST responses were intercepted fixtures; this proves client recovery behavior, not database persistence or server mutation semantics.
Phone-width web is smoke coverage; native iOS remains the primary phone workflow.
Earlier immutable proof files remain intact in the parent directory.
